title: Cancellation of normalized finite Cartier scalar adjuncts
statement: Let R,A be ordinary commutative rings, phi:R->A a unital map, N natural, N=0 in both rings, and Y any scheme with P=ProjectiveLine Y, W=diagonalSurface Y and i the diagonal. Let cR be a supported GeoCartierClass over R and cA,cAprime supported GeoCartierClasses over A, with positive Tate lines at exponent N. Suppose GeoCartierScalarCompatibility(phi,N,hR,hA,i,cR,cAprime) holds [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface]. Suppose every CartierScalarMaps with those parameters satisfies its Equation for cR,cA [def-diagonal-coefficient-arrow-transport]. Then cA=cAprime. The assertion requires no completion, canonical-class hypothesis, Noetherian hypothesis, or existence of a finite realization.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Extract eta,theta, their generator and root normalizations, the supported GeoCartierScalarUnit and the canonical square from GeoCartierScalarCompatibility. Build CartierScalarMaps from the same eta and theta and apply the other square.
Convert the supported GeoCartierScalarUnit into the exact restriction functor DerivedUnit, and apply its degree-two Ext bijection.
The two squares have the same right side. Their left sides are the two classes under the same injective Ext map. Apply injectivity.

theorem class_eq_of_scalar_square
    {R A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    (φ : R →+* A) {N : ℕ} {hR : (N : R) = 0} {hA : (N : A) = 0}
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (cR : GeoCartierClass R N hR (diagonalImmersion Y))
    (cA cA' : GeoCartierClass A N hA (diagonalImmersion Y))
    (hcompat : GeoCartierScalarCompatibility φ N hR hA (diagonalImmersion Y) cR cA')
    (hsq : ∀ maps : CartierScalarMaps φ N hR hA Y, maps.Equation cR cA) :
    cA = cA'
